records.description: Bayonne Energy Center is a gas-fired merchant generating facility in Bayonne, New Jersey, comprising BEC I, BEC II, and the dedicated cable connection into New York City's NYISO Zone J market. The approximately 660 MW dual-fuel asset sells wholesale energy, capacity, and ancillary services and provides dispatchable support to a constrained urban load pocket. MSIP acquired the facility in October 2018 and sold its full interest on July 23, 2026 to Tunnel Energy Investor, an Elliott-managed buyer formerly named Jupiter Energy Investor. BEC III, a separately proposed battery project, is not part of this thermal-generation record.

records.description: Flexential operates a U.S. data-center and digital-infrastructure platform providing colocation, cloud, interconnection, data protection, and managed and professional services to more than 3,000 customers across over 20 industries. The platform reports more than 40 data centers in 18 U.S. markets, over 380 MW online or under development, and a 100+ Gbps private backbone. GI Partners has sponsored the business since acquiring Peak 10 in June 2014 and completed a continuation-vehicle recapitalization in August 2025. Morgan Stanley Infrastructure Partners joined GI as a common-equity co-control owner in November 2024; their exact percentages and MSIP's fund and acquisition vehicle are not publicly disclosed.

records.description: Lightpath owns, builds, and operates metro and regional fiber networks serving enterprise, hyperscale, data-center, wireless, carrier, government, and institutional customers. The asset-heavy platform provides Internet, Ethernet, transport, wavelengths, private networks, dark fiber, voice, and managed connectivity. As of July 2026, Lightpath reported more than 12,100 route miles, over 18,000 service locations, more than 190 on-net data centers, eight cable landing stations, and operations across 11 metro markets. Optimum Communications retains 50.01% controlling common equity, while Morgan Stanley Infrastructure Partners holds 49.99% through NHIP III Lantern Holding LLC; no later common-equity transfer was identified.

records.description: Torch Clean Energy is an integrated U.S. renewable independent power producer that develops, owns, and monetizes utility-scale solar, wind, and battery-storage projects. The company reports more than 1.6 GW originated, developed, or sold across over 20 projects in eight states, with activity including the Desert Southwest, Michigan, and the Southeast. Morgan Stanley Infrastructure Partners announced its platform-equity investment on January 21, 2025 and continues to list Torch as a portfolio company. The exact legal closing date, stake, control terms, fund, acquisition vehicle, retained founder ownership, and any co-investors are not publicly disclosed.
